races.display_title: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict: Plenty of dead wood in this maiden and MARCESCENCE is selected to make it third time lucky having shaped promisingly when placed in a couple of Navan maidens. This step up to 7f looks a good move and she can get the better of Sonic Sabiha , who was suspended under the non-triers rule at Listowel in September but has run well here on both subsequent outings. Direct Action and Jade Fox can fight out minor honours. MARCESCENCE (IRE) SONIC SABIHA (IRE) DIRECT ACTION
